decisions.reason: The award-winning yogurt on fruit puree sits close to the core dairy range and costs little to keep, so its absence from the website in 2020 to 2021 is not enough to justify abandoning it.
The flagship Abendbrotkäse was a strategic focus and builds on existing cheese capabilities, so the option still merits holding despite no recent website evidence.
The multi-variant spicy cheese line can be pruned variant by variant rather than abandoned outright, though the lack of visibility since 2019 raises doubts about its value.

After four years this niche washed-rind soft cheese has shown no positive signal and has disappeared from view, so its uncertainty has resolved unfavourably and its resources are better redirected to the established business or new development.
